_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Computer Software System Document
summary: The Computer Software System Document fully describes the requirements of a software program, specifying its modules, functions, and subfunctions, and records the program's purpose and module breakdown.
description_purpose:
3.1 The Document fully describes the requirements of a Software Program. The Program is specified in terms of modules, functions of the modules, and subfunctions.
3.2 The Document will be used to record the purpose of a software system and provide a breakdown of program modules and their individual functions.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
7.2 The document required by this DID will be used by government in-house employees or contractor personnel.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: General.
preparation_instructions.content: The Computer Software System Document shall outline the function(s) of the system and shall break the software down by major component or module. Each module will be further subdivided into functions, and the subfunctions of each function shall be described in this document.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Format shall be as outlined below.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The document shall cover the following:

children.title: Purpose.
children.content: Address the purpose and intent of this document.

children.title: Scope.
children.content: Describe the scope that is intended by this document.

children.title: Components.
children.content: The functional components which the system supports shall be briefly described.

children.title: Information Transfer.
children.content: Outline the types of data transferred between system components.

children.title: Communication.
children.content: Outline the methodology of communication between system components.

children.title: Module Description.
children.content: Describe each major module of the system.

children.title: Section 3. Functional Requirements.
children.content: The requirements of each of the major modules of the system shall be described in this section. This description shall include all formulae and algorithms use by these modules. Each major module shall be broken down by its subfunctions.

children.title: Modules.
children.content: Each module should be covered within one level two header.

children.title: Each functional area that a module supports will be covered in a level three header.
children.content: The function supported shall in general be broken down into subfunctional program elements.

children.title: Each subfunctional program element shall be described in a level four header.
